paragraphs.text: Tigaden was a dwarf village in the Crimson Peaks of Sarpadia , on the world of Dominaria .

Due to its location near the hatching dragon eggs in the southern Crimson Peaks , Tigaden had once seen a dragon whelp wander into the village, looking for food. Five dwarves had tried tackling the creature, and it had bloodied them all until it was killed by spears and swords. Years later, the dwarf woman Melelki , who lived nearby, encountered Reod Dai in town, at the Squat Duck , the local inn. He offered to buy dragon eggs from her for 2 gold apiece, a handsome sum for a poor embroiderer. Each year for a total of 3 years they repeated the trade, meeting at the Squat Duck to trade.
